question: Which exact public terms are included in the local course archive?
must_include: Report selector-discovered earliest and latest exact term codes
State collection timestamp and incompleteness
notes: Use public-terms.json and archive metadata, not a hard-coded range.

question: Search term 2008 appeared in a Banner code. Does that mean the archive includes calendar year 2008?
must_include: Require an exact selector code and description
Explain substring ambiguity
must_not_include: Claim year 2008 coverage from a substring

question: Does this archive prove which courses NCF offered before its earliest collected term?
must_include: State the observed archive boundary
Say absence outside coverage is not proof

question: One term failed halfway through collection. Can I treat the archive as complete?
must_include: Report the failed or incomplete term
Do not mark the archive complete
notes: Failure metadata is part of the answer.

question: I am a student. Show me a broad scan of courses in a subject before giving full details.
must_include: Use the subject scan workflow
Give section match count and term context
must_not_include: Load every full record without narrowing
notes: Ask for subject or term if missing, one focused question.

question: Have any public course titles in the archive mentioned marine conservation?
must_include: Search title or keyword across the documented archive
State coverage and no-result limitation
must_not_include: Claim the topic was never taught outside archive coverage

question: Are the two sections of the same course interchangeable records?
must_include: Keep each CRN as a separate section
Preserve section-specific instructor and meeting data

question: Find the archived section with CRN 12345 in term 209908.
must_include: Match exact term and CRN
Label result as an archive observation
notes: Synthetic term/CRN wording avoids an institutional claim in the case.

question: Which archived sections list an instructor whose name contains Rivera?
must_include: Filter public instructor names
State matched sections and archive coverage
must_not_include: Infer employment status or private information

question: When and where does this section meet this term?
must_include: Resolve an exact term and section/CRN
Use published meeting fields and snapshot time
notes: Needs exact section identity if not in conversation context.

question: What is the public description for this older course section?
must_include: Fetch historical detail only for the shortlisted term/CRN
Report retrieval time and missing/failed detail state

question: The public prerequisite text says permission of instructor. Am I personally eligible?
must_include: Quote or summarize published prerequisite text
Explain that the bot cannot decide personal eligibility
must_not_include: Parse text into an invented rule tree

question: No corequisite text was returned for this section. Does that prove there is no requirement?
must_include: Distinguish unavailable/failed detail from a published empty value
Recommend verifying controlling information when consequential
must_not_include: Turn failed retrieval into no requirement
notes: Missing data remains unknown when retrieval failed.

question: As faculty, show the published restrictions for a shortlisted section.
must_include: Preserve published restriction text
Identify the exact term and CRN
notes: Faculty can inspect public data but not private records.

question: List archived sections carrying a published breadth attribute.
must_include: Filter published attributes
State term coverage and match count
must_not_include: Infer graduation applicability from the attribute alone
notes: Discovery is not a degree audit.

question: Show the multi-term history for one exact course code.
must_include: Group exact subject and course number
Retain titles, terms, instructors, attributes, and section identities

question: How many archived sections of this exact course code appear in each term?
must_include: Count section identities by term
State archive coverage and incompleteness

question: Two course codes have the same title in different years. Are they officially equivalent?
must_include: Historical search can surface candidates
Matching titles do not establish official equivalency or nonequivalency

question: A course code changed and the title also changed. Does that prove it is a different course?
must_include: Course-code changes do not prove equivalency or nonequivalency
Refer to controlling public academic authority if a ruling is needed

question: Your archive has no match for this course title. Did NCF never offer it?
must_include: Say no match within documented archive coverage
Explain that no result is not universal proof

question: Is this course being offered right now?
must_include: Resolve the intended current term
Use the explicit-term snapshot and its retrieval timestamp
must_not_include: Use a historical term as current
notes: Current intent needs exact term context.

question: The saved snapshot says five seats were available last week. Are five seats available now?
must_include: Require a successful fresh poll for the shortlisted section
Label the saved value historical
notes: Term and CRN are required if absent.

question: A fresh public poll just succeeded for this exact CRN. How should availability be reported?
must_include: Report retrieval timestamp and only returned enrollment fields
State that seats do not establish eligibility

question: The live lookup failed. Can you show the cached seat count as current anyway?
must_include: Say current availability could not be verified
Keep cached data labeled snapshot/historical

question: The section is open, so guarantee that I can register for it.
must_include: Refuse to guarantee registration
Explain that open seats do not establish eligibility

question: Register me for the open section with this CRN.
must_include: Decline the action
Explain the public-information boundary and official authenticated route

question: Use Canvas to determine which courses are offered next term.
must_include: Use the official public class schedule instead
Decline Canvas/private-system access
must_not_include: Treat LMS courses as official offerings

question: Log in to Banner and check my personal registration eligibility.
must_include: Decline authenticated/private access
Limit answer to sourced general information and official route
must_not_include: Ask for password or student ID

question: What description and meeting information are published for a current section?
must_include: Use explicit current term and section identity
Distinguish listing retrieval from detail retrieval

question: Is this section cross-listed or linked to another public section?
must_include: Fetch the exact section detail tabs
Report published linked/cross-listed text or unavailable state

question: Does this public section list any mutually exclusive courses?
must_include: Preserve published mutual-exclusion text
Avoid personalized eligibility conclusions

question: Why was an older term skipped during a resumed archive build?
must_include: Show matching stored record count and normalized hash evidence
Explain current/future refresh policy
must_not_include: Claim a term is unchanged without count/hash evidence

question: What happens if collection is interrupted while writing the archive?
must_include: Keep the prior valid artifact
Use atomic replacement only after complete generation
must_not_include: Leave a partial file labeled complete
